blocks.text: Loading, empty and failed are different states. A spinner can show activity while words explain what the app is waiting for.
Use an Ionic React starter with its setupIonicReact call and standard Ionic CSS imports. Put these components in App.tsx or App.jsx. The plain playground does not load Ionic styles or components.

items: `role="status"` lets a reading tool announce a changed message politely without moving focus to it.
`IonContent` owns the Ionic screen's scrolling content area. It works inside the starter app's page structure.

blocks.text: The app shows a spinner and a readable loading message.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Stop showing the loading state when work succeeds or fails. A spinner forever is not useful error handling.
